    Plamondon's selection of a brick band #

    Over a gentle algebra with good signs, an alternating cyclic word of minimal length either passes through distinct vertices, or yields a cyclic word of the shape P ω Q ω⁻¹ of Shape2; in both cases the band modules are bricks (Plamondon, τ-tilting finite gentle algebras are representation-finite, §4).
